title: Mathership Birthday Exact Asset Lineage, Surveillance and Cultural-Object Audit
scope: Attempt to elevate the Mothership Zeta birthday/happy-place finding from development-comment semantics to exact object-level lineage by separating base-form identity, placed-reference lineage, object-count coincidence, autobiographical-memory interpretation, cultural-object collection, and individual-surveillance claims.

literal_production_roots.timer_comment: This was the spot where the birthday stuff would pop up
literal_production_roots.preservation_rule: Literal strings are immutable evidence; no interpretation may replace them.

birthday_world_objects.role: birthday balloon family / Growing Up Fast

lineage_admission_levels.meaning: Birthday/happy-place feature existed as a development residue in the shipped/decompiled quest script.
CG02 is the strongest direct semantic source because it is the protagonist's canonical birthday sequence.
CG02 has four kid party hats and Zeta Cargo Hold has four adult party hats.
00028FF8 != 00050E44; the two hat sets are not the same base record.
No direct web-indexed Zeta reference to CG02/00028FF8/known birthday static FormIDs has yet been recovered.
Requires reference-level enumeration from locally owned Fallout3.esm/Zeta.esm using FO3Edit/xEdit or equivalent.

four_hat_hypothesis.claim: The exact count 4 in CG02 and 4 in Zeta Cargo Hold is potentially related to the removed birthday/happy-place feature.
positive_evidence: developer comment places birthday content inside the Zeta examination timeline
CG02 is the protagonist's canonical tenth birthday
both contexts contain exactly four hat objects
negative_or_limiting_evidence: Zeta Cargo Hold broadly contains collected pre-War Earth objects
Research Lab shows systematic collection/study of unrelated Earth cultural objects such as Giddyup Buttercup
required_escalation_evidence: a Zeta placed reference whose base is 00028FF8
a DLC05 reference to CG02 00014E84 or birthday statics 0009FAED/0009AE97/0009AE98/0009FE61
a disabled/deleted reference in the examination cell or adjacent feature whose base belongs to the Vault 101 birthday set

confirmed_nodes.node: Little Lamplight / Sticky / Happy Birthday to You

objects: four adult party hats among pre-War clothing

whole_game_birthday_party_pattern_scan.finding: Birthday/party imagery recurs across childhood, age-threshold, hallucination, death/dark humor, and alien-collection contexts. Recurrence alone does not establish a single hidden causal plot.

evidence: Mothership research areas collect terrestrial vehicles and large quantities of Giddyup Buttercup toys.
Alien captive log 21 has Sally explicitly explain that Giddyup Buttercup is a toy while questioning why the aliens possess it and why they are excited by it.
Alien captive log 3 describes abductees being made to record who they are before suspended animation and compares the process to catalog entries for a giant collection.
Cargo Hold stores pre-War Earth clothing and objects.
cultural_collection_competing_model.inference: The Zeta party hats can plausibly be cultural specimens whose human meaning is being catalogued or studied.

surveillance_and_parental_abduction_audi.explanation: A production plan to show autobiographical birthday imagery during examination can arise from player-memory/hallucination design without implying that Zetans observed the birthday in-world.

prewar_government.finding: Pentagon Library records an alien craft crash north of Hagerstown; recovery failed; report concludes humanity is not alone.

postwar_recovery_nodes: Theta crash site and alien blaster/power cells
Firelance random encounter with alien weapon/power cells
Fort Bannister alien power-cell cache with possible Enclave scientific inspection
Fort Independence / Brotherhood Outcasts alien power-cell recovery
Protector Casdin has unique dialogue identifying alien blaster/power cells as technology worthy of study
external_alien_awareness_in_fallout3.finding: Alien material is not wholly unknown to Capital Wasteland institutions; there are multiple independent material-contact nodes.

engineering.current_runtime_boundary: Official Fallout3.esm/Zeta.esm bytes are not present in this execution environment, so reference-level lineage is not claimed as executed.
